cards.text: Paul, a preacher of the good news about Jesus, and his traveling partner Silas are on the road again. They pass through Amphipolis and Apollonia and come to Thessalonica, a city with a Jewish synagogue. Two whole cities in one sentence, friend, and I need a nap after walking to my oven.

cards.question: When Paul gets to Thessalonica, he goes into the synagogue. True or false: this is something Paul does as his custom.

cards.text: Paul doesn't drop in once and leave. Three Sabbaths in a row, he reasons with them, and he uses a source everybody in that room already trusts.

cards.question: Over three Sabbaths in the Thessalonica synagogue, what does Paul reason with them from?
From the Scriptures, Paul explains and proves that the Christ had to ___ and rise from the dead.

cards.text: Then Paul brings it home. "This Jesus I am proclaiming to you is the Christ," he declares, and friend, three Sabbaths of buildup just went BOOM.

cards.question: True or false: after Paul's three Sabbaths in the synagogue, none of the Jews in Thessalonica are persuaded.
Some of the Jews in Thessalonica join Paul and Silas, along with a large number of God-fearing ___ and quite a few leading women.

cards.text: Things are going great in Thessalonica. But then the Jews become jealous.

cards.question: In Thessalonica, what do the jealous ones do about Paul and Silas?

answers.text: Report them to the high priest

cards.text: The mob sends the whole city into an uproar and raids the house of Jason, a man in Thessalonica, looking for Paul and Silas. A whole MOB for two preachers, friend, and the biggest uproar I ever caused was rolling over too loud in a junk drawer.

cards.question: True or false: the mob finds Paul and Silas inside Jason's house.

cards.text: So they drag Jason and some other brothers before the city officials, shouting that these men "have turned the world upside down." Friend, they meant that as an insult, and I'd stitch it on my apron.

cards.question: The mob tells the officials that Jason welcomed Paul and Silas into his home. What do they say all these men are doing?

cards.text: Defying the decrees of Caesar, the Roman emperor, and saying there's another king, named Jesus. On hearing this, the crowd and the city officials are greatly disturbed.

cards.question: What do the Thessalonica officials do with Jason and the other brothers?

cards.text: As soon as night falls, the brothers send Paul and Silas away to Berea. Heading out in the dark? Friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, the dark and I are on a first-name basis.

cards.question: Paul and Silas arrive in Berea. Where do they go?

cards.text: Now the text gives the people of Berea a compliment. They're more noble-minded than the Thessalonians.

cards.question: Why are the Bereans called more noble-minded than the Thessalonians?

answers.text: They received the message eagerly and checked it
They protected Paul from the angry mob
They built a bigger synagogue for Paul

cards.text: Every day they examine the Scriptures to see if these teachings are true. They double-check Paul like I double-check my oven timer, and friend, I've burned enough batches to know WHY.

cards.question: After all that eager searching of the Scriptures, ___ of the Bereans believe.
True or false: in Berea, quite a few prominent Greek women and men believe too.

cards.text: But news travels. The Jews from Thessalonica learn that Paul is proclaiming the word of God in Berea too.

cards.question: What do the Jews from Thessalonica do once they hear Paul is preaching in Berea?

answers.text: Go there to stir up the crowds
Send a warning letter to Caesar
Ask Jason to bring Paul back

cards.text: They go to a whole other city just to agitate a crowd. Some folks won't cross the kitchen to help you, and these folks crossed the MAP to cause trouble.

cards.question: With trouble in Berea, the brothers immediately send Paul to the ___.
True or false: Silas and Timothy, who travel with Paul, leave Berea with him.

cards.text: Some men escort Paul on the trip. They don't just drop him off at the coast, either. They bring him all the way to a new city.

cards.question: The men escorting Paul from Berea bring him to ___.
Paul's escorts head back with instructions for Silas and Timothy. What are they?

answers.text: Join Paul as soon as possible

cards.text: So Paul's in Athens, and his team has been told to hurry. Hang on to your apron, friend, because this journey is not done yet.

findings.problem: Stop 1, card 13 quotes "have turned the world upside down.", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: "Three Sabbaths in a row" adds a timing detail. Acts 17:2 says "on three Sabbaths" and never says they were back to back.

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

findings.problem: "They meant that as an insult" states the mob's intent as fact. Acts 17:6 gives the shout but never says why they said it or how they meant it. It needs to be marked as Papa Dorin's own guess, like "I bet they meant that as an insult."

rule.text: Feelings: He can guess at a feeling, marked as his own ("I think," "I bet"). Never as fact.

findings.problem: This card only restates what card 9's right answer already gave: the Thessalonian Jews go to Berea to stir up the crowds. It adds no new moment from the passage, so it is a recap carrying a joke.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage.

findings.problem: The story card has three sentences. Only the opening card may run to 3 sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The first sentence, "So Paul's in Athens, and his team has been told to hurry," recaps what cards 14 and 15 already answered. It also goes past the text: Acts 17:15 says the escorts returned with instructions, not that Silas and Timothy have received them. Since 17:15 is asked on a choice card, this card can be just the story-isn't-over line.

rule.text: When the passage's last verse is asked on a choice card, the last story card can be just this line.
